dict.nu are etichete: cititorul de ecran cite: has no tags: the screen reader reads the text in the order it is written in the file, which may differ from the one on screen.
dict.pe pagină față de cea de dinainte, în ac: on the page compared with the one before, in the same column: check that the order is natural.
